reader.requirement: At --std 85 a subscript written data-name-2 {+|-} integer-2 or index-name-1 {+|-} integer-3 must select the occurrence whose number is the data item's value (or the index's occurrence number) incremented or decremented by the integer, in every dimension, for qualified data-names, signed/COMP data-names, condition-name subscripts and variable-occurrence tables; the forms outside the 1985 format (integer zero or signed, compound expressions) are another rule's refusal.

edition-consulted.switches: ConstructRegistry check of subscript-arithmetic-expression-2002 for any subscript not a 1985 form (Cobol85OperandForms.IsSubscript); only refuses, the relative forms pass
ConstructRegistry.IsAvailable(subscript-arithmetic-expression-2002): at 85 refuses a data-name-2 with a scale (not an integer); no effect on evaluation

reader.edition-search: grep Edition/ConstructRegistry/CobolVersion in SubscriptBinder.cs and VersionConformancePass.cs; the evaluation (BindPosition -> PositionBinary Add/Subtract over PositionItemRead/PositionIndexCell) consults no edition
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the evaluation is one arm; only the admission of non-1985 forms differs (85 refuses arithmetic-expression subscripts, 2023 admits them)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness exercises only index-name + integer in one dimension; data-name +/- integer, index-name - integer, multi-dimension, condition-name, qualified data-name-2 and ODO tables are not exercised

probes.printed: COBOL0900 (requires COBOL-2002) for N + 0, IX - 0, N + 1 + 1, IX + 1.5, N * 1, 2 + N, F + 1 (F PIC 9V9), N + -1; at --std 2023 all compile and run
probes.expected: integer-2/3 is neither signed nor zero (§1985:III.2) and only data-name/index-name {+|-} integer is a 1985 relative form, so each is outside the 1985 format

probes.printed: CN-OK / CN-IX-OK / 03; with T(UX + 1) (UX of another table) COBOL1961
probes.expected: condition-name T-SEVEN(N OF G1 + 2) true (T(7)=7), T-SEVEN(IX - 2) with IX=9 true, T(N IN G2 + 1)=T(2)=03; foreign index refused by SR3

citations.check: OK  §1985:IV.4.3.8.2.4 GR4  (4.3.8.2.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR4

reader.notes: The relative subscript is lowered as a PositionBinary over the data item's occurrence read or the index cell, the same code at every edition; 1985 only adds the shape gate (VisitSubscriptPart) and the integer screen of data-name-2. Every probed form selected the right occurrence, as sender, receiver and condition-name subscript.

refuter.evidence: r1a.cob at --std 85: data-name-2 PACKED-DECIMAL, BINARY, SIGN LEADING/TRAILING SEPARATE +/- integer -> 55 11 33 99 (T(5),T(1),T(3),T(9)); index of the inner dimension written in the outer position C(CX + 1, RX + 1) / C(CX, RX - 1) -> 07 01 (C(2,3), C(1,1)); 3-dimension relative indexing C3(AX + 1, BX - 2, CCX + 2)=214, C3(AX, BX - 1, CCX - 1)=121; MOVE 3 TO N T(N + 1) -> T(4)=03, T(2) untouched (§1985:VI.6.19.4 GR2 subscript evaluated before each receiver); SEARCH WHEN T(IX + 2) = 66 stops at IX=4; PERFORM VARYING IX with T(IX + 1). r1b.cob: PIC 9(18) and S9(18) data-name-2 with 18-digit integer-2 -> 55 99; DIVIDE 7 BY 2 GIVING N REMAINDER T(N + 1) -> T(4)=01 (new N); ADD 1 TO N T(N + 1) -> T(3)=34 (§1985:VI.6.4.6 left-to-right). r1c.cob: data-name-2 PIC 9P VALUE 10 (an integer, SR5) admitted, T(P1 + 2)=12, T(P1 - 9)=01. r1d.cob (class c): S(1) + 1, S(1), FUNCTION INTEGER(2) [+ 1], ZERO + 1 each COBOL0900 at 85; N + 1 OF G COBOL0001. cite.py: OK §1985:IV.4.3.8.2.4 GR4; OK §1985:IV.4.3.8.2.3 SR5; OK §1985:VI.6.19.4 GR2; OK §1985:VI.6.4.6 (GR2).
